fields.label: Your story
fields.sample:
It all began on an ordinary Tuesday evening, in a small bookshop in Kadıköy. Two hands reaching for the same book at the same moment, a shy smile and the words “You take it, I'll wait”… One of us kept the book, the other the phone number.
Then came long walks, conversations that lasted until morning, cities we got lost in together. We became each other's best friend; in laughter and in hard times, we were always on the same side.
One summer evening, a single question asked outside the bookshop where we first met changed everything. The answer was short: “Yes.” Now we want to write the most beautiful page of this story together with you.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We're so lucky to have you; here's to meeting again on many more happy days.

elements.name: Üst başlık
elements.text: The verdict is in on a seven-year love story

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: A love that began in a bookshop heads to the altar. Families are overjoyed; friends say “we knew it.”

elements.name: Kapak altyazısı
elements.text: Photo 1 · The happy couple, caught by our lenses ahead of the big day. The smiles are real, the excitement sky-high.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: Happy ending to a seven-year romance: date set, venue set, dance floor ready

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
IS­TAN­BUL (Go Post) – A love story that began in a small book­shop in Kadıköy is head­ing to the altar. The owners of the two hands that reached for the same book at the same moment have de­cid­ed to make their seven-year re­la­tion­ship of­fi­cial. The first re­ac­tion came from the fam­i­lies: while the moth­ers could not hold back tears of joy, the fa­thers have re­port­ed­ly al­ready start­ed re­hears­ing their speeches.
Close friends, speak­ing to our paper, point­ed out that it came as no sur­prise, saying “it was ob­vi­ous from day one.” With prepa­ra­tions said to be in the final stretch, the couple has just one re­quest: that you be by their side that day.

elements.name: Bakış metni
elements.text: The cer­e­mo­ny will be held at sunset, by the sea. No cake for late­com­ers; just kid­ding, but the dance floor won't wait for anyone.

elements.name: Bakış metni
elements.text: The two families' joint state­ment was a single sen­tence: “We knew it all along.” The moth­ers are re­port­ed­ly al­ready stock­pil­ing tis­sues.

elements.name: Bakış metni
elements.text: Smart and com­fort­able. Don't forget your danc­ing shoes; the night is long, the floor is wide, the playlist is ready. White be­longs to the bride alone.

elements.name: Fihrist 3
elements.text: All the details: time, place, program

elements.name: Şerit yazısı
elements.text: Behind the scenes of the big day: the latest from backstage

elements.name: Flaş metni
elements.text: Sources say the bride ar­rived at the salon with three dif­fer­ent photos for her hair­style and, after long de­lib­er­a­tion, set­tled on a fourth. The stylist would only tell our paper: “the result is stun­ning.”

elements.name: Flaş metni
elements.text: The groom re­port­ed­ly changed his tie for the third time this morn­ing. Family sources say the final choice is de­fin­i­tive; claims that he car­ries a spare bow tie in his pocket have not been denied.

elements.name: Flaş metni
elements.text: The number of tiers on the cake, de­liv­ered to the venue in a spe­cial ve­hi­cle, is still a secret. The driver re­port­ed­ly took every curve with great care, and not a single swirl of frost­ing was smudged. The only clue: choco­late.

elements.name: Flaş metni
elements.text: With the wel­com­ing of the guests, the big day has of­fi­cial­ly begun. Early ar­rivals were served cold drinks while the mu­si­cians did their final tuning. Keep your tis­sues handy.

elements.name: Şerit yazısı
elements.text: Our reporters on the trail for seven years ▪ Exclusive images published for the first time ▪ Witnesses speak

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Our reporters followed the couple's seven years step by step. Four shots obtained from the scene appear here for the first time.

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: Moda seafront, one autumn evening. According to witnesses, the conversation lasted until dawn and the tea was refilled three times.

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: Their first vacation together: no map, no plan, plenty of laughs. Our photographer waited two hours for this shot.

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: Glasses on, distance closed. After this shot, friends declared it “official.”

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: The ring appeared; the answer came fast. The first shot from the scene; claims of a trembling hand have been denied.

elements.name: Tanık ifadesi
elements.text: “I saw the spark in their eyes on day one. I told no one, but I made a bet; I won.”

elements.name: Tanık ifadesi
elements.text: “Every phone call, they talked about each other. A mother's intuition never fails.”

elements.name: Tanık ifadesi
elements.text: “I picked the cake. I will make no further comment on the matter.”

elements.name: Tanık ifadesi
elements.text: “They brought the book back together, hand in hand. That's when I knew.”

elements.name: Tanık ifadesi
elements.text: “They used to order two coffees every morning. One day they asked for one cup, two spoons.”

elements.name: Tanık ifadesi
elements.text: “I got the invitation first. I've already framed it and hung it on my living room wall.”

elements.name: Kroki notu
elements.text: The area has been declared a “romantic zone” until the wedding day.

elements.name: Muhabir notu
elements.text: For seven years we tracked the couple: in cafés, on beach­es, at air­port gates. We wit­nessed only one fight, over whose turn it was to buy coffee, and it's still going. Our sources say a ref­er­ee will be ap­point­ed after the wed­ding. Our team will be at the table clos­est to the dance floor that night.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: Time, place, program and dress code: everything you need to know about the big day is on this page.

elements.name: Saat notu
elements.text: Doors open half an hour earlier

elements.text: Behind the love that began in a bookshop

elements.name: İmza
elements.text: Penned by the bride and groom

elements.name: Program notu
elements.text: Cocktails and live music in the garden

elements.name: Detay fotoğrafı altyazı
elements.text: After the final rehearsals, the couple posed for our cameras. The excitement shows; the happiness is complete.

elements.name: Kulis
elements.text: In­sid­ers say the groom has been se­cret­ly taking lessons for the first dance for weeks. The bride knows but is pre­tend­ing not to. Word is that the witnesses' speech­es have been capped at two min­utes, and anyone who runs over will have to settle for the last slice of cake. The playlist will re­port­ed­ly keep chang­ing until the very last minute, and only two people know the first-dance song.

elements.name: Uyarı metni
elements.text: Access to the dance floor is unrestricted. Guests who stay seated all night will be personally invited to the floor by the bride. Comfortable shoes are recommended.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: So no one is left out when we count tables, please let us know at least two weeks ahead.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: For being part of our story

elements.name: Liste notu
elements.text: for selling that book to both of us

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: You take the lead on the dance floor; have your shoes ready.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: You'll be first to the buffet. Don't overlook the dessert table.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: The most talked-about conversation of the night will be at your table.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: You're very likely to get emotional during the vows; tissues are a must.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: The cameras love you. Start practicing your best pose now.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: You'll memorize the seating plan; nobody will end up at the wrong table.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: A tough choice between cake and dancing awaits you.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: Keep the secrets you know, tonight too.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: By the end of the night, you'll have a new friend.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: After 23:00 the ties come loose; you should loosen up, too.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: A surprise song request from you will bring the floor to its feet.

elements.name: Burç yorumu
elements.text: The slow songs will sweep you away; keep someone close.

elements.name: Okur mektubu
elements.text: Dear Editor, your last issue reported that the couple has been rehearsing their dance. As their neighbors, we can confirm it: the same song has played every evening for three weeks. We kindly request a little quiet after the wedding. Still, we congratulate the couple and confess that the song is now our favorite, too. One more request: when it plays, call us to the dance floor as well.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: A dance queen and king for the night. Ap­pli­ca­tions ac­cept­ed on the dance floor until dawn.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: One light­ly used “who apol­o­gizes first” ar­gu­ment. Seven years old; price firm.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: The bride's calm, one week before the wed­ding. If found, please bring chamomile tea.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: A heart, in a book­shop in Kadıköy. De­liv­ered to its owner; no take-backs.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: The groom's game con­sole. Ex­pect­ed to see little use in the coming months.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Halay, waltz and tango. Crash course until the wed­ding; first lesson free.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Witnesses' speech­es are lim­it­ed to two min­utes. Anyone who runs over gets dish duty.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Will trade coffee-run turns. Offers will be con­sid­ered after the wed­ding.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Can­di­dates de­ter­mined to catch the bou­quet, please line up. Only one rule: fair play.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: The groom's bach­e­lor plan­ner. Find­ers, please don't return it; a plan­ner for two is now in use.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: Comfy shoes, lots of laughs, an open heart. That's tonight's recipe.

elements.name: İlan metni
elements.text: To ev­ery­one who read this paper to the very end: see you on the dance floor.

elements.name: Alt şerit yazısı
elements.text: Bride and groom have packed for the honeymoon ▪ Go Post · printed with love
